facts.business: Raminfo Limited operates in digital public infrastructure, GovTech, AI solutions, and green energy through its subsidiaries, providing IT services to government and expanding into rooftop solar and clean energy projects.

guidance_or_targets.statement: As the company enters FY 2026–27, the temporary election-related lull has completely passed, yielding a powerful resurgence in business momentum characterized by a noticeable revival in government-led project inquiries, active RFPs, and bidding tenders.
guidance_or_targets.value: Revival in government-led project inquiries, active RFPs, and bidding tenders

key_risks: Provident fund damages and interest dispute (INR 63.71 Lakhs provision from 2015-16)
Dependence on government projects and election cycles
facts.related_party_note: Investments in subsidiaries include Raminfo Digitech Private Limited, Raminfo Health Private Limited, Raminfo Greentronics Private Limited, Raminfo Greentech Private Limited, Raminfo Greenenergy Private Limited, Icollab Foundation, Kisan Drones Private Limited, Jaaga Real Estate Private Limited, Modern MVUS Services Private Limited, and Karkinos Healthcare Private Limited (CCPS converted to equity).
